ddl.value: ("template_id" IS NOT NULL AND "checklist_id" IS NULL) OR ("template_id" IS NULL AND "checklist_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: item_owner

ddl.value: ("opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "client_id" IS NULL) OR ("opportunity_id" IS NULL AND "client_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: reference_owner

ddl.value: ("kind" = 'url' AND "url" IS NOT NULL AND ("url" LIKE 'https://%' OR "url" LIKE 'http://%') AND "target_client_id" IS NULL AND "target_opportunity_id" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'client' AND "target_client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "url" IS NULL AND "target_opportunity_id" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'opportunity' AND "target_opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "url" IS NULL AND "target_client_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: reference_target

ddl.value: "source_stage" IS NULL OR ("opportunity_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_stage" IN ('new-lead', 'active-lead', 'under-contract', 'closed'))
ddl.name: task_source_stage
